jobs.description:
We are looking for a PhD candidate to study neural organoids to predict neuroinvasive viruses We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to work as a doctoral candidate on the MSCA-DN DETECTIVE project. For rapid control of virus outbreaks, fast availability of antivirals is a major bottleneck. In DETECTIVE, innovative models will be used for setting up an antiviral testing pipeline without the need for animals models. This doctoral project will focus on developing patient-derived organotypic models to test and optimise broad-spectrum antiviral therapies. Organotypic models, such as human organoids, are miniaturised in vitro organ cultures that mimic the human tissue-specific context. In this project, gut organoid models co-cultured with immune cells will be used to determine antiviral efficacy of available broadly acting antiviral against a scala of outbreak viruses such as enteroviruses and West-Nile virus. Patient-specific responses to virus infections will be assessed with integrated -omics techniques, and patient-dependent responses to antiviral therapy will be used to develop personalized medicine regimens for the future. With this project we will set the stage for an innovative human antiviral testing pipeline for viral outbreaks. At the Amsterdam UMC, DETECTIVE is looking for a doctoral candidate (DC) to work on Work Package 1. As DC6, your objectives are: To establish patient-derived gut organoid mucosa models To test a panel of broadly acting antiviral compounds in patient-derived gut mucosa organoid models To identify virus and host factors determining treatment response by transcriptomics and proteomics You will be supervised by: Dr. Katja Wolthers Dr. Adithya Sridhar You will undertake international secondments within the DETECTIVE network, including: the Dutch Public Health Institute (Utrecht, Netherlands) the University of Tampere (Tampere, Finland) These secondments will provide exposure to both academic and industrial research

environments and offer opportunities to develop complementary scientific and transferable skills. master’s degree in biomedical sciences, infection, immunity or related fields; experience working with mammalian cell culture, qPCR, and bioinformatics is preferred; experience working with stem cells and organoids is desirable; excellent oral and written communication skills in English (minimum C1/C2 CEFR level); an interest in self-development and working in a multidisciplinary research environment. MSCA eligibility requirements Mobility rule: Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the Netherlands for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding recruitment (1 March 2027). Doctoral degree requirement: Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the time of recruitment. A contract at Amsterdam UMC for 36 hours per week for 4 years. The opportunity to work on large-scale and in-house research with motivated colleagues from all over the world. Interdisciplinary network-wide training schools (one week each): Foundations in Virology, Bioinformatics and Epidemiology Advanced Integration of Scientific, Diagnostic and Public Health Virology, Translational Virology and connecting Academia, Clinical Practice and Public Health for Pandemic Preparedness. Individually tailored career development plan and personal empowerment program. Classification in salary scale OIO: € 3.217 to € 4.077 gross for full-time employment (depending on education and experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. A holiday allowance of 8% and a year-end bonus of 8.3% of the gross annual salary. 100% reimbursement for public transport travel costs. jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to ride along with an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. A €150 net Bring a Friend bonus, subject to the applicable conditions. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier

is not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Apply through Consolid for the position of Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
